description: This file defines the LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams class, which extends a DateRangeSearchFilterParams class, and is used to encode search filter parameters for leave requests within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes properties and methods for filtering leave requests by statuses, employee numbers, subunit IDs, leave type IDs, and inclusion criteria for employees. The class also enforces validation on status filters and sets default sorting behavior.

classes.name: LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for filtering leave request searches, including criteria such as statuses, employee identifiers, subunit IDs, leave types, and inclusion options. It enforces validation on statuses and provides default sorting behavior.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave statuses used for filtering leave requests.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses for filtering after validating against allowed statuses, converting them to internal representation.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number criterion for filtering.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves the array of employee numbers used for filtering.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getSubunitId
methods.description: Returns the subunit ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setSubunitId
methods.description: Sets the subunit ID for filtering.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID for filtering.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the inclusion setting for employees (current, past, or both).

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion setting for employees.
